actions.batch_scrape.description: Start a batch job that scrapes a list of known URLs and returns a job ID.
actions.batch_scrape.props.format.descri: Which representation of each page to return.
actions.batch_scrape.props.maxConcurrenc: Maximum number of URLs scraped in parallel.
actions.batch_scrape.props.onlyMainConte: Return only the main content of each page, excluding headers, navs, footers, etc.
actions.batch_scrape.props.timeout.descr: Maximum time to wait for each page to load, in milliseconds.
actions.batch_scrape.props.urls.descript: The list of page URLs to scrape (at least one). Obtain them from Search Web or Map Website if needed.
actions.cancel_batch_scrape.description: Cancel an in-flight batch scrape job by its ID.
The ID of the batch scrape job to cancel. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.
actions.cancel_crawl.description: Cancel an in-flight crawl job by its ID.
actions.cancel_crawl.props.crawlId.descr: The ID of the crawl job to cancel. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or List Active Crawls.
actions.crawl.description: Read many pages of a site by following links from a start URL.
actions.crawl.props.cache_note.descripti: Pages read in the last 2 days may come from Firecrawl's cache.
actions.crawl.props.formats.description: What the step returns for each page.
actions.crawl.props.limit.description: Most pages to read. Empty: Firecrawl's limit of 10,000.
actions.crawl.props.prompt.description: Which pages to read, in plain words. Empty: pages under the start URL.
actions.crawl.props.timeout.description: Seconds to wait. The crawl keeps running after a timeout.
actions.crawl.props.url.description: The crawl follows links from this page.
actions.crawl.props.useWebhook.descripti: Firecrawl posts each event to your URL as the crawl runs.
actions.crawlResults.description: Get the status and pages of a crawl started earlier.
actions.crawlResults.props.crawlId.descr: The id in the webhook events of a Crawl step.
actions.crawl_website.description: Crawl a website starting from a base URL and return the content of many pages.
actions.crawl_website.props.format.descr: Which representation of each page to return.
actions.crawl_website.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of pages to crawl.
actions.crawl_website.props.onlyMainCont: Return only the main content of each page, excluding headers, navs, footers, etc.
actions.crawl_website.props.timeout.desc: Seconds to poll for completion before giving up. Keep well under the action time limit for large crawls; for big jobs prefer Crawl Website with a smaller limit or poll separately via Get Crawl Results.
actions.crawl_website.props.url.descript: The base URL to start crawling from (e.g. https://example.com). Obtain it from Search Web or Map Website if needed.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.extract.description: Pull structured data from one or more pages with AI.
actions.extract.props.enableWebSearch.de: Also search the web for related pages and context.
actions.extract.props.prompt.description: What to pull from the page, in plain words.
actions.extract.props.timeout.descriptio: Seconds to wait. The job keeps running after a timeout.
actions.extract.props.urls.description: Pages to read. End a URL with /* to cover a whole site.
actions.extract_data.description: Extract structured data from one or more known URLs using AI.
actions.extract_data.props.enableWebSear: Allow the extraction to use web search for additional context.
actions.extract_data.props.prompt.descri: Describe what information to extract from the pages.
actions.extract_data.props.schema.descri: A JSON Schema object describing the structured fields to extract (e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}},"required":["title"]}). See https://json-schema.org for the format.
actions.extract_data.props.timeout.descr: Seconds to poll for completion before giving up.
actions.extract_data.props.urls.descript: One or more page URLs to extract data from. Obtain them from Search Web or Map Website if needed.
actions.get_agent_status.description: Get the status and result of a Firecrawl (FIRE-1) agent job by its ID.
actions.get_agent_status.props.jobId.des: The ID of the agent job to check. Obtain it from the Start Agent action result.
actions.get_batch_scrape_errors.descript: List the URLs that failed in a batch scrape job.
actions.get_batch_scrape_errors.props.jo: The ID of the batch scrape job whose errors to list. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.
actions.get_batch_scrape_results.descrip: Get the status and accumulated page results of a batch scrape job by its ID.
actions.get_batch_scrape_results.props.j: The ID of the batch scrape job to check. Obtain it from the Batch Scrape action result.
actions.get_crawl_errors.description: List the URLs that failed or were blocked in a crawl job.
actions.get_crawl_errors.props.crawlId.d: The ID of the crawl job whose errors to list. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or List Active Crawls.
actions.get_crawl_results.description: Get the status and accumulated page results of a crawl job by its ID.
The ID of the crawl job to check. Obtain it from the Crawl Website action result or from List Active Crawls.
actions.list_active_crawls.description: List the account's in-flight crawl jobs.
actions.map.description: List the links found on a website.
actions.map.props.limit.description: Most links to return, up to 100,000.
actions.map.props.subdomain.description: Also list pages on subdomains, like blog.example.com.
actions.map.props.url.description: The site to list links from.
actions.map_website.description: Discover and return the list of URLs reachable from a website.
actions.map_website.props.includeSubdoma: Include pages from subdomains (e.g. blog.example.com) in addition to the main domain.
actions.map_website.props.limit.descript: Maximum number of links to return (max: 100,000).
actions.map_website.props.search.descrip: Optional keyword to filter the discovered URLs (e.g. "blog" to return only blog paths).
actions.map_website.props.url.descriptio: The website URL to map (e.g. https://example.com).
actions.scrape.description: Read one web page as Markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or JSON.
actions.scrape.props.actionProperties.de: Properties for actions that will be performed on the page.
actions.scrape.props.formats.description: What the step returns for the page.
actions.scrape.props.screenshot_note.des: A full-page screenshot is also saved with every scrape.
actions.scrape.props.storeInCache.descri: On: Firecrawl keeps the page and may serve a cached copy.
actions.scrape.props.timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the page to load.
actions.scrape.props.useActions.descript: Click, type or wait on the page before it is read.
actions.scrape_url.description: Fetch the content of a single web page in a chosen format.
actions.scrape_url.props.format.descript: Which representation of the page to return.
actions.scrape_url.props.onlyMainContent: Return only the main content of the page, excluding headers, navs, footers, etc.
actions.scrape_url.props.timeout.descrip: Maximum time to wait for the page to load, in milliseconds.
actions.scrape_url.props.url.description: The exact web page URL to scrape (e.g. https://example.com/about). Obtain candidate URLs from Search Web or Map Website if you do not already have one.
actions.search_web.description: Search the web, news, or images for a query. Optionally include each result page as markdown.
actions.search_web.props.country.descrip: Optional ISO country code to bias results (e.g. "us").
actions.search_web.props.includePageCont: Also return each result page as markdown (for image results, the page the image is on). Each result with page content uses scrape credits.
actions.search_web.props.lang.descriptio: Optional ISO language code to bias results (e.g. "en").
actions.search_web.props.limit.descripti: Maximum number of results to return for each source (max 100).
actions.search_web.props.location.descri: Optional location to search from (e.g. "San Francisco,California,United States").
actions.search_web.props.query.descripti: The search query (keywords, like a Google search).
actions.search_web.props.sources.descrip: Where to search: "web", "news" or "images". Defaults to web only.
actions.search_web.props.timeFilter.desc: Only return results from this time range: qdr:h (past hour), qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (past week), qdr:m (past month) or qdr:y (past year). Leave empty for any time.
actions.search_web.props.timeout.descrip: Maximum time to wait for the search, in milliseconds. Allow more time when Include Page Content is on.
actions.start_agent.description: Start an autonomous Firecrawl (FIRE-1) agent job from a natural-language prompt.
actions.start_agent.props.maxCredits.des: Optional credit budget cap for the agent run.
actions.start_agent.props.prompt.descrip: Natural-language instruction describing what the agent should accomplish.
actions.start_agent.props.schema.descrip: Optional JSON Schema describing the structured result to produce.
actions.start_agent.props.strictConstrai: If enabled, the agent may only visit the provided URLs and will not navigate elsewhere.
actions.start_agent.props.urls.descripti: Optional starting URLs for the agent. Obtain them from Search Web or Map Website if needed.
auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Firecrawl API Key:

1. Sign in or create an account at [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys?utm_source=activepieces&utm_medium=integration).
2. Copy your API key from the API Keys page.
description: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.
